clean.title: Which split a decision tree prefers
clean.body:
A decision tree picks split A. Gini impurity measures how mixed a group is; lower means purer. In split A each group is 3 of one class and 1 of the other, so Gini = 1 - (0.75² + 0.25²) = 0.375, and the weighted Gini is also 0.375. In split B each group is an even 2 and 2, so Gini = 1 - (0.5² + 0.5²) = 0.5.

Because 0.375 is lower than 0.5, split A leaves purer groups and is chosen.
